name: Resident Card for Family Members of a Resident Foreigner

requirements.blocker_text: Decret 05-322 P-RM contains no distinct 'regroupement familial' (family reunification) category -- a spouse or family member joining a foreigner already resident in Mali applies for their OWN carte de resident under the same general conditions as any other immigrant: valid passport, medical certificate under 2 months old, criminal record extract under 3 months old, and documentation of means of existence. The one family-specific provision found (Article 34) requires foreign children of resident immigrants to apply for their own resident card within 15 days of turning 18, submitting parental-authorization references and supporting documents -- before that age they are presumably covered under a parent's status, though the decree does not spell this out explicitly.
requirements.fix_path: Have the joining family member apply for their own carte de resident under the general conditions; a child of a resident foreigner must separately apply for a card within 15 days of turning 18.

outcome.duration_length: resident card, renewable, exact validity period not specified in the decree

sources.title: Decret 05-322 P-RM (hosted via ILO NATLEX) -- general resident-card regime and Article 34's provision for children of resident foreigners turning 18

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mali). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to Mali's own official decree, tier 1 (via ILO NATLEX); a dedicated search for a separate 'regroupement familial' law or decree specific to Mali returned nothing -- every result was French domestic-law material, confirming this is a genuine structural absence rather than a fetch failure. GENUINE FINDING, MARQUEE FOR THIS FILE: Mali's foreigners' law does not carve out a distinct family-reunification track at all -- family members follow the exact same general carte de resident process as any other immigrant, with only Article 34's child-turning-18 provision addressing family status specifically. work_rights set to 'restricted' since no source confirmed unrestricted labor-market access purely from this card, separate from a family member's own work permit if employed. family_can_work left null: not addressed by the source reviewed.
